Roofing in Logan

Local roofer covering Springwood, Shailer Park, Daisy Hill, Beenleigh and Loganholme. Free quotes, and we reply within 24 hours.

  • Free quote within 24 hours
  • Licensed, insured and local
  • 10-year workmanship guarantee
  • Locally owned since 2012
Get a Free Quote in Logan {{ custom_values.site_phone_display }}
  • Licensed and insured
  • 12+ years local
  • Workmanship guarantee

{text:body}

A lot of Logan homes went up in the 80s and 90s, and the concrete tiles on them are now 30 to 40 years old. At that age the ridge capping has usually cracked, the bedding mortar has crumbled and the tile coating has worn off, so most of our Logan work is repointing and restoration, which costs far less than a new roof. Around Daisy Hill and Shailer Park the bushland drops a steady load of leaves and gum nuts into gutters and valleys, and that is where many of the leaks we find begin. Beenleigh and the older streets near the Logan River have more timber homes with metal roofs. Those tend to need new screws, fresh flashings and the odd rusted sheet replaced. Summer storms roll through most years, and after a bad one we put tarping and emergency repairs for Logan customers at the front of the queue. We're in Logan most weeks, so an inspection is usually only a couple of days away.

FAQ

Questions we get asked a lot

Can't see your question? Call {{ custom_values.business_owner_name }} and the team and we'll give you a straight answer.

Call {{ custom_values.site_phone_display }}
How much does a roof repair cost?

Most repairs fall between $350 and $1,500 depending on access and materials. We give you a fixed written price before any work starts, so there are no surprises.

How quickly can you come out?

We usually inspect within 1 to 2 business days, and same day for active leaks and storm damage.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes. We hold a current QBCC licence and full public liability insurance, and we are happy to send certificates before we start.

Do you offer a guarantee?

Every job comes with our 10-year workmanship guarantee on top of the manufacturer warranty on materials.

Which areas do you service?

We service Brisbane, Logan, Ipswich, Redcliffe, Springfield, Moreton Bay, Redland City and surrounding suburbs.
